{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data with proper parsing
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] != 'refunded']

# Create a stratified comparison: compare within each customer segment
# First, compute conversion rate within each segment by channel
conversion_by_segment_channel = sales_df.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("Conversion rate by segment and channel:\n", conversion_by_segment_channel)

# Compute the difference in conversion rate within each segment
conversion_diff = conversion_by_segment_channel['email'] - conversion_by_segment_channel['paid_search']
print("\nConversion rate difference (email - paid_search) by segment:\n", conversion_diff)

# Check if the campaign effect is consistent within segments
# If the email campaign did better in all segments, it's likely effective
# But if it only did better in one segment, that may be due to targeting

# Return results
(conversion_by_segment_channel, conversion_diff)"}
